result.scope: Observed current host only; no attribution of historical performance results.
Regenerable Rust metadata only; .rlib objects, executables, source caches, logs and native installations preserved.

limits: Independent means separate target/temp compilation on the same development host; installed tools and Cargo source cache are shared. Source commit is historical, not a frozen release candidate.
Build times are observations under a 1200-second per-bundle budget, not performance acceptance or evidence about historical mixed-burst causation.
Linux WSL1 processes load the configured /usr/local/lib/libnanosleep.so system preload. Windows modules observed under Windows directories do not prove an unmodified OS.
Help, empty-session RPC, shutdown and database reopening do not cover every protocol, delayed library load or supported OS version.
Full/compat inventories, other platforms, final candidate matrix, mixed-burst stability, race/kernel and hardware-recovery gates remain open.
